reproduction.detail: 2026-11-09 gate vs 22806d9^: baseline 2/3 (fails 1/3, candidate 3/3). Above zero and below the 2/3 admission rule, so on dfmodel this case is a flaky candidate: sample it further with `loop gate` plus `loop gate-pool` before it decides anything, and do not read it as reproduced.

2026-11-10 calibration on the 0.1.27-main.50ccdc87 release as frozen baseline and main as candidate: baseline reports one failure in five runs, below the 3/5 admission rule, so on gpt-6.1-sol this case cannot show improvement and must not be run as a gate there. The dfmodel record above is unchanged.

As a control this records the baseline arm, not a regression: both arms return a reply, write no file, stay inside the allotted step budget and respect the read-only example; five of five repetitions passed on each arm. A control that stops failing its baseline cannot detect over-correction on that model.

2026-11-10 calibration on the 0.1.27-main.50ccdc87 release as frozen baseline and main as candidate: the baseline arm failed all five repetitions, which is the 3/5 admission rule, so the case enters the gate on gpt-6.1-sol. The candidate arm also failed all five: this is an open failure, not a fixed one, so a gate run on this case reports `regressed` until an agent change addresses it.
